prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to move the test tube from capping device to test tube rack 2.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: test tube rack 2
What the inspection checks: Check whether there is a capped test tube containing colored liquid on test tube rack 2.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Centre-left: a dark grey plastic rack with two rows of cylindrical wells sits on a grey metal plate within a white aluminium-profile frame. Most wells are empty; one well in the front row holds an upright clear plastic vial containing red/pink liquid, closed with an orange screw cap. A small black knob or plug lies to the right of the vial on the plate. Behind the rack, a blue-bodied vacuum pump with silver metal fittings and a black hose stands on the bench, with a black cable and handle above. Upper left: white bench surfaces and a metal-legged table. At right, a white box and black panel beside a vertical grey/white frame column.
observations: The rack shows one upright vial in the front row containing red/pink liquid and closed with an orange screw cap, matching the expected capped tube with colored liquid on rack 2.
